name: Poly Haven
summary: CC0 HDRIs, textures and 3D models from Poly Haven: list and search assets, read an asset's metadata and its downloadable files by resolution and format.

user_agent.description: A unique User-Agent naming your software, which Poly Haven's terms require on every call so it can group your app's requests.

notes: Free and keyless, including commercial use. The terms require a unique User-Agent (or Referer) naming your software on every call: set POLYHAVEN_USER_AGENT.
Surfacing Poly Haven content through the live API requires a visible credit to Poly Haven in your product; the downloaded CC0 assets themselves need no attribution.
Asset types are hdris, textures and models. Use search for relevance, then assets or info for metadata, then files for download URLs.

endpoints.name: List assets
endpoints.summary: Every asset with its metadata, keyed by asset id, optionally filtered by type, category, collection or vault.

category.description: A category path from the taxonomy, canonical ('Brick & Block/Clay Brick') or slug ('brick-block/clay-brick'); a parent includes its children.

categories.description: (Legacy) Comma-separated categories; an asset must match all of them.

notes: The docs list no paging parameters: the matching set comes back in one response.

endpoints.name: Search assets
endpoints.summary: Hybrid semantic and keyword search over asset metadata, in any language; returns the full ranked list of matching asset slugs.

q.description: The query; send it trimmed and lower-cased.

min.description: Minimum similarity score; 0.35 by default, 0 returns every asset ranked.

limit.description: Return at most this many results; total still reports the full count.

future.description: Include early-access assets not yet published.

notes: Returns slugs only: look up each slug's metadata with assets.list or assets.get.

endpoints.name: List an asset's files
endpoints.summary: A tree of the asset's downloadable files, organized by resolution and file format.

endpoints.name: Get the category taxonomy
endpoints.summary: The category tree and attribute schema for one asset type.

endpoints.name: Get an author
endpoints.summary: An author's name, links and, when available, email.
